role: Static render-info helper: reads the GL modelview/projection/viewport to get the unprojected view-object coordinates, and computes the yaw/pitch rotation basis every billboard pass uses, plus the block at the entity viewpoint for fog.

members.name: objectX
members.note: the gluUnProject path is not ported; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: viewport
members.note: GL state reads are not ported; the raster passes compute matrices natively

members.name: updateRenderInfo
members.note: the first-person rotation basis is recomputed per pass in raster_particles.c (recorded and live) and the GL matrix reads are folded into the native camera math; objectX/Y/Z from gluUnProject are not ported

members.name: projectViewFromEntity
members.note: folded into play.c:build_rs's interpolated eye position used for the viewpoint block

members.name: getBlockAtEntityViewpoint
members.note: interpolated eye, floor, liquid height offset 0.11111111 and the one-block-up probe

members.name: ActiveRenderInfo
members.note: never constructed: every member is static (lane/covclient)

notes: The rotation basis appears twice in raster_particles.c (recorded scene path and live path) with the same formulas. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): GL plumbing: GL is the numerical oracle, not emitted (SPEC); atlases and meshes are consumed as data.
